scope: Read-only dependency audit for DOMAIN contract planning; no source, tests, Git, network, Vault, model, or egress actions.

packet.objective: Typed knowledge relations, structured comparison, graph and retrieval fusion

baseline.head: 8728aafc9aa7af5caf90d60bfa6ab2ba89419f75
baseline.working_tree_note: Three untracked CODE-r7 paths were present; audit evidence is from committed HEAD and does not inspect or include them.

findings.title: Domain/comparison profile and immutable profile head are missing
findings.present: The catalog has a fixed base-catalog generation profile and runtime/dependency/resource fingerprints; no domain/comparison profile schema, publisher, or atomic current profile head is present.
findings.needed: Versioned profile identity, allowed dimensions/units/predicates, immutable publication and current-head validation with stale refusal.

findings.title: Typed annotations, relation predicates and current annotation heads are missing
findings.present: Paper/claim records and assessment history exist, but there is no typed annotation schema, predicate registry, annotation review event, or current annotation-head resolver.
findings.needed: Deterministic typed concept/claim/method/dataset/model annotations, registered predicates, review transitions, and named current heads.

findings.title: Structured experiment conditions and comparability lint are missing
findings.present: The code-alignment schema fixes five capability buckets and paper conversion preserves section claims; neither captures normalized experiment conditions nor comparability outcomes.
findings.needed: Structured condition dimensions (data, split, metric, protocol, budget and implementation context), deterministic lint, and explicit not_comparable/unknown results.

findings.title: Support/contradiction graph semantics are absent
findings.present: supports/contradicts/uncertain currently describe a flat evidence locator relation transported by ledger-locator; no typed claim-to-claim support, counterevidence, contradiction group, or unknown semantics are projected.
findings.needed: Validated relation edges with provenance, direction, contradiction candidates/groups, counterevidence and unresolved/unknown states.

findings.title: Deterministic typed graph projection, generation and query are missing
findings.present: catalog_index.py creates evidence units, mappings, BM25 chunks and fixed record joins; there is no graph namespace, typed projector, graph generation manifest, or graph query route.
findings.needed: Canonical sorted graph nodes/edges, deterministic projection and generation fingerprints, typed traversal/query, and complete dependency hashes.

findings.title: Reviewed paper-repository/config relations and officiality evidence are incomplete
findings.present: paper-record, repo-record and paper-code-alignment carry metadata, capability buckets and officiality fields, but no reviewed typed paper-repo-method/config edges or relation evidence extension exists.
findings.needed: Versioned Paper/Repo/Method/Config/Checkpoint relation records with locator evidence, officiality rationale, review state and conservative mismatch handling.

findings.title: Retrieval has BM25 evidence ranking but no exact/typed-graph/paper-code fusion
findings.present: retrieval.py validates policy, mappings, gold and BM25 evidence-unit hits; it has no exact identifier route, typed graph route, or paper-code fusion contract.
findings.needed: Deterministic exact, lexical and typed-graph routes with source/claim/code alignment, per-route diagnostics and stale dependency checks.

findings.title: Existing RRF only fuses original and rewritten lexical routes
findings.present: light_query.py fixes fusion rrf-v1 for original/rewrite lexical chunk routes; it does not define graph, exact, comparison or paper-code route inputs while retaining old behavior.
findings.needed: An additive fusion contract preserving existing lexical results and adding typed/exact/comparison routes, stable tie-breaking and route provenance.

findings.title: Budgeted comparison context pack is not implemented
findings.present: No context-pack module or schema records included/omitted items, rank, reason, support/counterevidence, unknowns, or budget accounting.
findings.needed: Deterministic bounded pack with complete selection rationale, typed graph paths, supporting/counterevidence and explicit unknown/not-comparable coverage.

findings.title: Catalog status and coverage diagnostics omit graph/comparison dependencies
findings.present: Live status checks catalog generation, mapping, configuration and stale BM25 inputs; no graph/comparison generation, profile/head, annotation-head or coverage diagnostics are checked.
findings.needed: Generation and dependency manifests for graph/profile/comparison, current-head checks, coverage/contradiction/comparability diagnostics, and fail-closed query behavior.

dependency_conclusion.reason: The accepted lower-level source, code-evidence, catalog and lexical retrieval primitives do not yet define the immutable typed domain/comparison state, graph semantics, structured conditions, fusion routes, or context-pack/staleness contracts required by DOMAIN.
